record.field: Search for my calendar events (model_name: calendar.event) of today. Find the events on which I'm an organizer (field_name: user_id) or one of the attendees (field_name: partner_ids). Don't mention model_name or field_name, or any record ids in the response. The response should be a list of events with their name, start hour and stop hour and whether I'm an organizer or an attendee.
